subtitle.zh: 接触操作 · 场景与演示

description.zh: 从打开笔记本到持杯接水，记录 ARX5 桌面双臂场景中的操作目标、初始布局和仿真演示。
description.en: From opening a laptop to filling a cup, explore task goals, starting layouts, and simulation recordings on the dual-arm ARX5 tabletop workstation.

notice.zh: “演示已完成”表示这次操作已有完整录像和机械动作复核记录。各任务的进展说明列出了已验证的环节。当前目录未发布基准分数或成功率。
notice.en: A completed demonstration has a full recording and a mechanical review for that run. Each task lists what has been checked. Benchmark scores and success rates are currently unreported.

label.zh: 头部相机 · 完整演示

description.zh: 已有完整机械演示及复核证据；不等于统一 benchmark 验收。
description.en: A complete mechanical demonstration has review evidence; this is not unified benchmark acceptance.

description.zh: 已有运行入口、局部验证或开发录像，完整操作仍有待完成。
description.en: A runtime entry, local validation, or development recording exists; complete operation remains under development.

description.zh: ARX5 桌面双臂场景已接入，完整动作尚待开发。
description.en: The task has a dual-arm ARX5 tabletop scene, with work on the full action still pending.

description.zh: ARX5 双臂平台的接触操作与触觉记录，涵盖插接、开盖、持杯及双手协作。
description.en: Contact manipulation and tactile recordings on the dual-arm ARX5, covering insertion, opening, cup handling, and coordinated manipulation.

description.zh: 19 项工具任务及折叠刀 B 变体；原生资产与局部动力学证据单独记录。
description.en: 19 tool tasks plus folding-knife B; native assets and local dynamics evidence are tracked separately.

description.zh: 十项组合任务；无机器人短探针不作为完整操作成功。
description.en: Ten composed tasks; robot-free short probes are not complete-operation successes.

title.en: Open a laptop with both arms

description.en: Laptop base, lid, and two arms

objective.en: Open a laptop with both arms

prompt.zh: 用右夹爪提起笔记本上盖的前缘，左夹爪压稳底座，将上盖完全打开。随后松开并撤回夹爪，让笔记本保持打开、底座平稳。
prompt.en: Lift the front edge of the laptop lid with the right gripper while steadying the base with the left, until the lid is fully open. Release and withdraw both grippers, leaving the laptop open and stable.

successCriteria.zh: 从合盖状态开始，支撑底座并将上盖打开到 105°–115°。
successCriteria.en: Start with the lid closed, support the base, and open the lid to 105°–115°.

successCriteria.zh: 撤手后检查上盖保持。该次记录的最终角度为 109.6°，保持了 3 秒。
successCriteria.en: Check that the lid stays open after the arms withdraw. The recorded final angle was 109.6° with a three-second hold.

objects.en: Laptop base, lid, and two arms

statusNote.zh: 已完成闭合初态开盖、撤手与保持的机械演示。固定布局参考记录，benchmark 评分仍待定义。
statusNote.en: A closed-start opening, hand withdrawal, and passive hold passed mechanical review. This is a fixed-layout reference, with benchmark scoring pending.

alt.zh: 双臂打开笔记本的机械演示录制画面
alt.en: Recorded mechanical demonstration of open a laptop with both arms

title.en: Open a bottle with an opener

objective.en: Open a bottle with an opener

prompt.zh: 用左夹爪拿稳瓶子，右夹爪拿起开瓶器并卡住瓶盖边缘。将瓶盖撬下，使它与瓶口完全分离。
prompt.en: Hold the bottle securely with the left gripper and use the right gripper to engage the opener under the cap edge. Pry the cap completely off the bottle.

successCriteria.zh: 检查瓶盖脱离瓶口，瓶身在工作面上稳定至少 1 秒。
successCriteria.en: Check that the cap clears the bottle and the supported bottle stays stable for at least one second.

statusNote.zh: 工程演示记录 complete_task_validated=true。task_accepted=false，数值收敛及完整 benchmark 验收尚未完成。
statusNote.en: The engineering record has complete_task_validated=true and task_accepted=false. Numerical convergence and full benchmark acceptance are incomplete.

alt.zh: 开瓶器开盖的机械演示录制画面
alt.en: Recorded mechanical demonstration of open a bottle with an opener

description.en: Three-pin plug and fixed power strip

prompt.zh: 拿起三脚插头，对齐固定插排中间的插孔，推入直到完全入座。
prompt.en: Pick up the three-pin plug, align it with the middle socket of the fixed power strip, and push it in until fully seated.

successCriteria.zh: 抬起插头并插入指定插座。就位检查允许的端面间隙为 1.5 mm。
successCriteria.en: Lift the plug and insert it into the designated socket. The seating check allows a face gap of 1.5 mm.

successCriteria.zh: 检查夹爪打开后的保持阶段。该次记录含 2.92 秒无右夹爪接触的就位画面。
successCriteria.en: Check the hold after the gripper opens. The recording shows 2.92 seconds of seating without contact from the right gripper pads.

objects.en: Three-pin plug and fixed power strip

statusNote.zh: 固定布局机械演示已检查抓取、插入、释放与稳定就位。记录为 review_ready，不是 benchmark 分数。
statusNote.en: A fixed-layout mechanical demonstration checks grasp, insertion, release, and stable seating. Its review_ready status is not a benchmark score.

alt.zh: 三脚插头插接的机械演示录制画面
alt.en: Recorded mechanical demonstration of insert a three-pin plug

description.en: Occlusion box, eraser, wooden block, and bottle

prompt.zh: 依次抓取盒内的各个物体，将先前抓取的物体放回盒内。最后只把最近一次接触的物体取出盒外。
prompt.en: Grasp each object inside the box in turn, returning the earlier objects to the box. Finish by taking only the last object you touched out of the box.

successCriteria.zh: 核对接触顺序，前一物体需放回到距原位 10 mm 以内。
successCriteria.en: Check the touch sequence and return the preceding object to within 10 mm of its starting position.

successCriteria.zh: 取出的物体应是最后接触的物体，出盒后稳定保持至少 1 秒。
successCriteria.en: Extract the object touched last and hold it steady outside the box for at least one second.

objects.en: Occlusion box, eraser, wooden block, and bottle

statusNote.zh: 接触顺序、放回和取出保持的机械演示已复核。使用特权位姿反馈，不代表盲操作或学得的触觉识别能力。
statusNote.en: Mechanical contact order, replacement, extraction, and hold were reviewed. Privileged pose feedback is used; this does not establish blind manipulation or learned tactile recognition.

alt.zh: 取回最后接触的物体的机械演示录制画面
alt.en: Recorded mechanical demonstration of retrieve the last-touched object

title.en: Fill a held cup from a faucet

objective.en: Fill a held cup from a faucet

prompt.zh: 左夹爪把杯子稳稳拿在水龙头下，右夹爪打开阀门接水。接水后关闭阀门，并继续拿稳装有水的杯子。
prompt.en: Hold the cup under the faucet with the left gripper and open the valve with the right to collect water. Then close the valve while keeping the cup secure.

successCriteria.zh: 打开阀门接水，再关闭阀门。解析水载荷模型记录的最大杯内体积为 327 mL。
successCriteria.en: Open and close the valve to fill the cup. The analytical water-load model recorded a peak cup volume of 327 mL.

successCriteria.zh: 检查闭阀后的持杯稳定性。该次记录的最终保持阶段持续 3 秒。
successCriteria.en: Check the cup after the valve closes. The final recorded hold lasted three seconds.

statusNote.zh: 原生持杯、开关阀与最终保持的机械演示已复核。采用解析水载荷模型，不是流体仿真或 benchmark 成功率结果。
statusNote.en: The native held-cup, valve, and final-hold demonstration passed mechanical review. It uses an analytic water-load model, not fluid simulation or benchmark success-rate evaluation.

alt.zh: 持杯接水的机械演示录制画面
alt.en: Recorded mechanical demonstration of fill a held cup from a faucet

objective.zh: 将试管对准试管架并插入孔位。
objective.en: Align the test tubes with the rack and insert them into the holes.

prompt.zh: 将三支试管逐一对准试管架的孔位并插入，松开夹爪，让它们竖直稳放在架内。
prompt.en: Insert the three test tubes into the rack one by one. Release them so that all three remain upright and securely seated.

statusNote.zh: 双 ARX5 的运行记录已确认两侧夹爪与物体接触。该次插管未达到任务成功条件。
statusNote.en: The dual-ARX5 recording verifies contact on both grippers. The insertion attempt did not reach task success.

alt.zh: 双 ARX5、试管与试管架的初始摆放
alt.en: Initial positions of the two ARX5 arms, test tubes, and rack

description.en: Mouse, bottom cover, and USB receiver

prompt.zh: 拿起并翻转鼠标，按下底盖尾部，取下翘起的底盖。再将 USB 接收器从收纳槽中完整取出。
prompt.en: Pick up and turn over the mouse, press the tail of the bottom cover, and remove the tilted cover. Then take the USB receiver completely out of its storage slot.

objects.en: Mouse, bottom cover, and USB receiver

statusNote.zh: 独立 PhysX 遥操适配存在。原自动任务的保持模型与完整交接尚未验收。
statusNote.en: An independent PhysX teleoperation adapter exists; retention dynamics and full automatic handover remain unvalidated.

alt.zh: 取出鼠标接收器的双 ARX5 桌面初始布局渲染图
alt.en: Dual-arm ARX5 starting layout for Extract a mouse receiver

title.zh: 沿线寻找 HDMI 插头

description.zh: HDMI 线缆、插头、盒与接口
description.en: HDMI cable, plugs, box, and port

objective.zh: 沿线寻找 HDMI 插头

prompt.zh: 从盒外伸入并抓住线缆主体，沿线找到一个 HDMI 插头。将插头取出盒外，对齐 HDMI 接口并插入到位。
prompt.en: Reach into the box and grasp the cable body, then follow it to an HDMI plug. Retrieve the plug from the box and insert it fully into the HDMI port.

objects.zh: HDMI 线缆、插头、盒与接口
objects.en: HDMI cable, plugs, box, and port

statusNote.zh: 已有局部抓线证据及独立 PhysX 分段线缆遥操。不等于连续 FEM 的完整找线与插接验证。
statusNote.en: Local cable-grasp evidence and an independent segmented PhysX teleoperation adapter exist; these do not validate complete continuous-FEM tracing and insertion.

alt.zh: 沿线寻找 HDMI 插头的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of trace an hdmi cable

prompt.zh: 左夹爪拿起锤子，交给右夹爪接稳后松开，再沿锤柄换一个位置重新抓住。最后右夹爪松开退离，由左夹爪独立稳握，全程保持锤子悬空。
prompt.en: Pick up the hammer with the left gripper, hand it to the right, then release the left and regrasp a different position along the handle. Finish with the right gripper released and clear and the left holding the hammer alone, keeping it off the table throughout.

statusNote.zh: v18 nominal 包仍标记 experimental。局部抓持与规划证据不代表双臂端到端成功。
statusNote.en: The v18 nominal package remains experimental. Local grasping and planning evidence does not establish bimanual end-to-end success.

alt.zh: 锤子交接与重抓的双 ARX5 桌面初始布局渲染图
alt.en: Dual-arm ARX5 starting layout for Hammer handover and regrasp

description.zh: 胶带环、大间隙配合用杆

prompt.zh: 左夹爪拿起胶带环，右夹爪拿起大间隙版本的穿杆。对齐环孔并将杆穿过，直到杆端从另一侧露出，让环和杆保持悬空。
prompt.en: Pick up the tape ring with the left gripper and the rod for the wider-clearance variant with the right. Align the rod with the bore and pass it through until the tip emerges on the other side, keeping both objects above the table.

objects.zh: 胶带环、大间隙配合用杆

statusNote.zh: v18 coarse 包仍为 experimental。coarse 指几何配合变体，完整任务验收尚待完成。
statusNote.en: The v18 coarse package remains experimental. Coarse identifies the geometric-fit variant; full task acceptance is pending.

alt.zh: 胶带环与穿杆在双 ARX5 桌面上的初始布局（大间隙）
alt.en: Dual-arm ARX5 starting layout for tape-ring threading (wide clearance)

description.zh: 胶带环、小间隙配合用杆

prompt.zh: 左夹爪拿起胶带环，右夹爪拿起小间隙版本的穿杆。仔细对齐环孔并将杆穿过，直到杆端从另一侧露出，让环和杆保持悬空。
prompt.en: Pick up the tape ring with the left gripper and the rod for the tighter-clearance variant with the right. Carefully align the rod with the bore and pass it through until the tip emerges on the other side, keeping both objects above the table.

objects.zh: 胶带环、小间隙配合用杆

statusNote.zh: v18 fine 为更小几何余量的变体，仍标记 experimental。不是触觉网格精度选项。
statusNote.en: The v18 fine variant has smaller geometric clearance and remains experimental; it is not a tactile-mesh resolution option.

alt.zh: 胶带环与穿杆在双 ARX5 桌面上的初始布局（小间隙）
alt.en: Dual-arm ARX5 starting layout for tape-ring threading (tight clearance)

title.en: Cut steak with a knife and fork

description.en: Table knife, fork, steak, and plate

objective.en: Cut steak with a knife and fork

prompt.zh: 用刀叉从牛排上切下一块肉。
prompt.en: Use the knife and fork to cut a piece off the steak.

objects.en: Table knife, fork, steak, and plate

statusNote.zh: 局部分离检查中，切下的肉块保持独立碰撞，切后相对移动 84 mm。完整机器人刀叉操作尚未验收。
statusNote.en: In a local separation check, the cut pieces retained independent collision and moved 84 mm relative to one another. Complete robot knife-and-fork operation is not accepted.

alt.zh: 刀叉切牛排的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of cut steak with a knife and fork

prompt.zh: 将茶壶中的液体倒入茶杯，再扶正茶壶停止倒水，并放回桌面。
prompt.en: Pour liquid from the teapot into the cup, then return the teapot upright to stop the flow and place it on the table.

statusNote.zh: 局部倒水检查中，对准杯口时记录接收 46.0 mL。容器负载与接收量已有记录，完整机器人倒茶流程仍待完成。
statusNote.en: A local pouring check recorded 46.0 mL received when aligned with the cup. Container loading and received volume are recorded; a complete robot pouring sequence remains pending.

alt.zh: 倒茶的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of pour tea

prompt.zh: 将砧板上的黄瓜切下一片。
prompt.en: Cut a slice off the cucumber on the cutting board.

statusNote.zh: 局部分离检查中，瓜片可独立运动，切后相对移动 229 mm。它验证预设分割模型的响应，不是完整机器人切片演示。
statusNote.en: A local separation check produced independently moving slices with 229 mm relative movement. It validates the predefined separation model, not complete robot slicing.

alt.zh: 黄瓜切片的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of slice a cucumber

prompt.zh: 颠动平底锅，让鱼翻面后落回锅内。
prompt.en: Toss the fish with the frying pan so it flips over and lands back in the pan.

statusNote.zh: 局部颠锅工况中，鱼离锅最高约 200 mm 后落回。该记录不等于机器人完成持锅、翻面与装盘。
statusNote.en: In a local pan-motion check, the fish rose about 200 mm above the pan and returned. This does not establish robot pan handling, flipping, and plating.

alt.zh: 颠锅翻鱼的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of flip fish with a pan

prompt.zh: 保持锅稳定，用锅铲将鱼翻面并放回锅内。
prompt.en: Keep the pan steady and use the spatula to turn the fish over and return it to the pan.

statusNote.zh: 局部接触检查中，铲缘承托将鱼抬高 7.9 mm。已有落稳与接触画面，完整机器人翻面仍待完成。
statusNote.en: In a local contact check, the spatula edge lifted the fish 7.9 mm. Settling and contact images exist; complete robot flipping remains pending.

alt.zh: 锅铲翻鱼的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of flip fish with a spatula

prompt.zh: 用调料瓶向食物表面撒入调料，再扶正瓶身停止出料。
prompt.en: Shake seasoning onto the food, then return the shaker upright to stop dispensing.

statusNote.zh: 局部撒料检查记录食物接到 1.0 mL。在途、接收与洒落量分别记录，完整机器人持瓶撒料仍待完成。
statusNote.en: A local seasoning check recorded 1.0 mL reaching the food, with in-flight, received, and spilled amounts tracked separately. Complete robot seasoning remains pending.

alt.zh: 撒调料的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of season food

description.en: Ladle, source bowl, and receiving bowl

prompt.zh: 用汤勺把源碗中的汤舀入接收碗，再将勺口转回朝上。
prompt.en: Ladle soup from the source bowl into the receiving bowl, then turn the ladle upright again.

objects.en: Ladle, source bowl, and receiving bowl

statusNote.zh: 局部舀取与转移检查中，接收碗得到 9.0 mL。该量测不等于机器人完成持勺、舀取和搬运。
statusNote.en: A local scooping-and-transfer check recorded 9.0 mL in the receiving bowl. This measurement is not a completed robot spoon-handling and transfer task.

alt.zh: 舀汤的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of ladle soup

prompt.zh: 搬起装有三只空酒杯的托盘，平移一小段后放回桌面。让三只杯子始终直立在托盘上。
prompt.en: Lift the tray holding three empty glasses, move it a short distance, and set it back on the table. Keep all three glasses upright on the tray throughout.

statusNote.zh: 局部抬升检查中，三只空杯随托盘升高约 54 mm。完整双臂搬运与放置仍待完成。
statusNote.en: In a local lift check, three empty glasses rose about 54 mm with the tray. Complete bimanual transport and placement remain pending.

alt.zh: 搬运酒杯托盘的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of carry a tray of glasses

prompt.zh: 让擀面杖贴着桌面向前滚动，再反向滚回。
prompt.en: Roll the rolling pin forward and back while keeping it in contact with the tabletop.

statusNote.zh: 桌面滚动试验中，木杖轴心前移 50.6 mm。它与垫板上滚动 8 cm 的 roll_pin 任务分开记录，尚无完整机器人演示。
statusNote.en: The pin center moved forward 50.6 mm in a tabletop rolling trial. This is separate from the 8 cm mat-based roll_pin task; a complete robot demonstration is pending.

alt.zh: 擀面杖滚动工况的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of rolling-pin interaction trial

description.zh: V006 折叠刀 A、左侧单钩架
description.en: V006 folding knife A and left-side single-hook rack

prompt.zh: 在仿真中展示折叠刀 A 从当前状态变为展开状态。
prompt.en: In simulation, demonstrate folding knife A transitioning from its current state to an unfolded state.

objects.zh: V006 折叠刀 A、左侧单钩架
objects.en: V006 folding knife A and left-side single-hook rack

statusNote.zh: 当前 V006 A 与左侧单钩架已有原生场景和刚体参数记录。较早的抓取、交接与开合片段属于局部开发，完整操作仍待复核。
statusNote.en: The current V006 A and left-side single-hook rack have native scenes and rigid-body records. Earlier grasping, handover, and opening clips are partial development records; complete operation still needs review.

alt.zh: 折叠刀 A 的桌面初始场景
alt.en: Tabletop setup with folding knife A

title.en: Extend and retract a utility blade

description.zh: ArtVIP 3 号伸缩刀、左侧单钩架
description.en: ArtVIP No. 3 utility knife and left-side single-hook rack

objective.en: Extend and retract a utility blade

prompt.zh: 在仿真中展示伸缩刀片伸出并保持，再回到收回状态。
prompt.en: In simulation, demonstrate the utility blade reaching and holding an extended state, then returning to a retracted state.

objects.zh: ArtVIP 3 号伸缩刀、左侧单钩架
objects.en: ArtVIP No. 3 utility knife and left-side single-hook rack

statusNote.zh: 当前使用 ArtVIP 3 号与左侧单钩架，已有初始场景和原生参数记录。完整机器人操作演示待完成。
statusNote.en: The current scene uses ArtVIP No. 3 and a left-side single-hook rack, with starting scenes and native parameter records; complete robot operation remains pending.

alt.zh: 伸缩刀片的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of extend and retract a utility blade

description.zh: T 柄内六角工具、螺栓、工件
description.en: T-handle hex driver, bolt, and workpiece

prompt.zh: 用 T 柄内六角工具将已旋入的螺栓拧紧至就座，再移开工具。
prompt.en: Use the T-handle hex driver to tighten the bolt in the workpiece until seated, then remove the tool.

objects.zh: T 柄内六角工具、螺栓、工件
objects.en: T-handle hex driver, bolt, and workpiece

statusNote.zh: 局部工况中，工件转动 106.9°，进给 0.297 mm。记录证明该工况的配合响应，不等于机器人完成整项紧固操作。
statusNote.en: The workpiece rotated 106.9° with 0.297 mm advance in a local check. This demonstrates the tested interaction, not a complete robot fastening task.

alt.zh: 内六角紧固的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of tighten a hex-socket bolt

prompt.zh: 操作斜口钳的两根手柄，让钳口张开后再合拢。
prompt.en: Move the two handles of the diagonal cutters to open and then close the jaws.

statusNote.zh: 局部动作检查中，斜口钳工作端间距变化 7.1 mm。这里只验证开合响应，不声称已完成材料切断。
statusNote.en: A local motion check measured a 7.1 mm change in the diagonal cutters’ working-end gap. It checks opening response, not completed material cutting.

alt.zh: 斜口钳开合的任务场景预览
alt.en: Task-scene preview of open and close diagonal cutters

prompt.zh: 操作尖嘴钳的两根手柄，让两侧钳尖分开后再靠拢。
prompt.en: Move the two handles of the long-nose pliers so the jaw tips separate and come together again.
